facts.fact: Delft Imaging's February 2020 magazine piece says Eritrea's Ministry of Health is joining forces with Delft Imaging and Thirona to use the offline CAD4TB chest X-ray AI to screen for TB, with no screening figures given.

note: An AI malaria app built by Ministry of Information staff and a doctor; the passages do not say any public health system uses it.

facts.fact: Delft Imaging says Eritrea's Ministry of Health procured a CAD4TB unit in 2018, had 2 Delft Light and 6 CAD4TB deployed in 2024 and expanded the roll-out with 8 more CAD4TB in 2026, to automatically detect TB-related abnormalities.
